description: This Java class defines a servlet filter named CookieClearingFilter used within the OpenMRS project. Its purpose is to remove specified cookies, especially session cookies like JSESSIONID, when a user logs out. It is configurable via runtime properties and extends the OncePerRequestFilter class from Spring framework. The core logic involves intercepting the request, performing actions before and after the main request processing, and clearing cookies if session invalidation occurs.

classes.name: CookieClearingFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that clears specified cookies when a user logs out, to ensure session cookies are removed and user logout is handled securely.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the method from OncePerRequestFilter to process the request, determine which cookies to clear, and perform cookie cleanup after the main request processing, especially on session invalidation.
